notes.title: Demo Release Date
notes.content:
Hello, the "Herd is Coming" playable demo will be available on 20 May 2019 The release time is approximately the following :

13:00 - GMT
06:00 - PST
21:00 - CST
22:00 - JST

The demo limitations are :

* Time limit : Unlimited
* Zombie spawn : Unlimited
* Zombie loot : Unlimited
* Level Cap : 10
* Save limit : Quick save only
* Demo ends : At certain location

Best regards, Proximity Games.
